regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing but not one-narrative US equity landscape: AI Infrastructure leads with fading valuation state and only mixed Hurst, while Cybersecurity is the clear challenger with perfect breadth and trend durability but crowded positioning. The only validated edge here is drawdown/shake-out avoidance via the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true); momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, and this desk note defaults to low conviction given the weak directional accuracy in the track record.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Cybersecurity (CIBR) closes the 0.342 score margin over AI Infrastructure (SMH) for five consecutive sessions — a CONFIRMED leadership handoff would retire this watch; a re-widening of the margin back above 0.5 would also retire it.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the only theme combining strong challenger momentum (rank 2, score 1.638), the highest durability_bar (0.85), clean 'trend' Hurst, and perfect breadth (1.0), meaning every constituent is participating — the most coherent trend-health profile on the board. The crowding_z of 1.8 flags it as a sizing caution, not a fade, and the guardrails explicitly permit naming a durable narrative with a checkable lean.
evidence: durability_bar 0.85, the highest in the eligible set
theses.dissent: Crowded at 1.8z with tight ownership likely means a lot of the trend is already priced; strong breadth and durability can persist yet still mean-revert in crowded software themes once inflows stall.

falsifier.text: CIBR closes below its 50-day moving average for five straight sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure remains the dominant headline narrative (weight 0.25, rank 1) with the highest score (1.98) and healthy breadth (0.708), but its durability_bar is middling (0.68) and valuation state is 'fading', so this is a presence-preserving lean, not a chase. The trend-gate leg (the only validated edge) supports staying in the leader for drawdown control rather than exiting on the fading valuation flag.
evidence: headline id ai_infra, weight 0.25, rank 1, score 1.98
theses.dissent: Valuation state 'fading' plus mixed Hurst suggests the leader's trend may be stalling; the handoff margin to Cybersecurity has already narrowed to 0.342 and could invert quickly.

falsifier.text: SMH lags Cybersecurity (CIBR) by 300 basis points over any rolling 10-session window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the highest-ranked non-tech theme (rank 4, score 1.005) with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag and solid breadth (0.727), suggesting durable cross-sector participation outside the crowded AI/software complex. Its durability_bar (0.68) matches the leader's, and it is far from crowded (0.83z), so it offers trend exposure without the ownership risk flagged in Cybersecurity.
theses.dissent: Energy is a macro-beta and oil-supply story more than a thematic one; the macro narrative backdrop is dominated by markets/geopolitics (not energy), and a risk-off rotation would hit it alongside everything else.

falsifier.text: XLE underperforms SMH by 500 basis points before the check-by date while its breadth drops below 0.5.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
